title: Resetting a sample to the analysis grid
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Going back to the analysis grid

  Scenario: Reset removes your warp markers
    Given "steady-120.wav" has warp markers of mine
    When I run "apricity import --reset-markers steady-120.wav"
    Then it has no warp markers of mine
    And compiling "steady.apr" pins 4.500 s to beat 8 again
    And the output says "steady-120.wav: 18 warp markers removed; the analysis grid is back"

  Scenario: Reset with none is harmless
    Given "steady-120.wav" has no warp markers of mine
    When I run "apricity import --reset-markers steady-120.wav"
    Then the output says "steady-120.wav: no warp markers of yours" and the command succeeds

  Scenario: Reset keeps your other markers and clips
    Given "steady-120.wav" has warp markers of mine, a marker "cue" and a clip "riff"
    When I reset its warp markers
    Then the marker "cue" and the clip "riff" are still there
```
